title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: multiple Sales Order Agents per company, with relevance filtering and larger PDF limits
summary: Pass. The roadmap facts, documented controls and Copilot Credit rates support the briefing. It correctly distinguishes automatic capability availability from instance activation and reports the conflicting mailbox-folder guidance rather than choosing one source.

claims.claim: Item matching first uses exact item number, vendor item number, GTIN or cross-reference identifiers.
claims.quote: Exact identifier match by item number, vendor item number, GTIN, or cross-references. Exact identifier matches have the highest confidence.

claims.claim: The second matching layer uses attributes such as colour, material and size with AI relevance ranking.
claims.quote: Semantic attribute matching uses item attributes from the customer's message (such as color, material, or size) and AI to rank candidates by relevance.

claims.claim: A broader search across all items follows unsuccessful direct and attribute-based searches.
claims.quote: Broader fuzzy search falls back to a global search across all items when the direct and attribute-based searches don't produce results.

claims.claim: The agent checks incoming messages against a relevance model before processing.
claims.quote: The agent validates incoming messages and attachments against a relevance model before it processes them.

claims.claim: Offers to sell, discount requests and attempts to access internal data are filtered out.
claims.quote: For example, it filters out offers to sell, discount requests, or attempts to access internal data.

claims.claim: Attachments receive a separate relevance check.
claims.quote: A separate check runs on attachments to ensure non-sales-related documents don't trigger unnecessary processing.

claims.claim: Non-sales attachments such as terms and conditions are ignored.
claims.quote: For example, if a customer attaches terms and conditions or a privacy policy alongside a purchase order, the agent processes only the purchase order and ignores the non-sales attachments.

claims.quote: The agent always involves designated Business Central users to review and approve all outgoing messages before it sends them to customers.

claims.quote: When off, the agent creates or modifies sales quotes as requested and then automatically proceeds with creating an outgoing email with the quote as an attachment. The user must review and confirm the email before the agent sends it to the customer. | Off |

claims.quote: When off, the agent creates the sales order as requested and then automatically proceeds with creating an outgoing email with the order as an attachment. The user must review and confirm the order before the agent sends it to the customer. | Off |
